mapper.insert: insert into PRIZM_PMS_CORE_RISK( mbid, user_code, ssa_shop_type, ssa_bank_account, ssa_bank_name, ssa_bank_account_holder, cbc_bank_name, mur_mb_demand_acc_bank_code, mur_mb_demand_acc_holder, mur_mb_demand_acc_number, balance_remittance_amount, input_date ) select mur.mbid as MBID, mur.user_code as USER_CODE, ssa.shop_type AS SSA_SHOP_TYPE, ssa.bank_account AS SSA_BANK_ACCOUNT, ssa.bank_name AS SSA_BANK_NAME, ssa.bank_account_holder AS SSA_BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER, cbc.bank_name AS CBC_BANK_NAME, mur.mb_demand_acc_bank_code AS MUR_MB_DEMAND_ACC_BANK_CODE, mur.mb_demand_acc_holder AS MUR_MB_DEMAND_ACC_HOLDER, mur.mb_demand_acc_number AS MUR_MB_DEMAND_ACC_NUMBER, (select balance_remittance_amount from MONEYBANK_REDEM_CALCULATE mrc where mrc.mbid=mur.mbid order by mrc.input_date desc limit 1) as balance_remittance_amount,now() as input_date from MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur left join CBCI_ACCOUNT ca on ca.USER_CODE = mur.user_code left join SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API ssa on ssa.shop_type =ca.SHOP_TYPE and ssa.shop_id = ca.SHOP_ID and DATE_FORMAT(ssa.settlement_date,'%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(SUBDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 38 DAY),'%Y%m%d') left join CBCI_BANK_CODE cbc on cbc.bank_code =mur.mb_demand_acc_bank_code where ca.SHOP_TYPE = 11 group by mur.mbid
mapper.select: select mur.mbid ,mur.user_code from MONEYBANK_USER_REQUEST mur where mur.mb_status in (6,62,63)
select shop_type ,shop_id from CBCI_ACCOUNT where user_code=#{user_code} and shop_type in (2,3,4,11,14)
select DATEDIFF(now(),input_date) from PRIZM_PMS_RESULT order by input_date DESC limit 1
select count(*) as cnt from PRIZM_PMS_RESULT

SELECT SSA_T.BSV_2W, SSA_T.BSV_1W, SSA_T.BSQ_2W, SSA_T.BSQ_1W, SSA_T.BPR_2W, SSA_T.BPR_1W, SSA_T.BSTS_2W, SSA_T.BSTS_1W, SSA_T.BDS_2W, SSA_T.BDS_1W, SSA_T.BDLT_2W, SSA_T.BDLT_1W FROM ( SELECT
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(PAYMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSV_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(PAYMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSV_1W
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ORDER_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSV_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ORDER_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSV_1W
,(SELECT COUNT(ORDER_NO) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSQ_2W ,(SELECT COUNT(ORDER_NO) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=${shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSQ_1W
,(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(order_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_2W ,(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(order_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_1W
,(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_2W ,(select IFNULL(SUM(seller_discounts_amount + shopping_mall_discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_1W
,(select IFNULL(SUM(discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_2W ,(select IFNULL(SUM(discount_amount)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_1W
,(select IFNULL(SUM(product_instant_discount_amount+product_discount_coupon_amount+product_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discount_coupon_amount+seller_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discounts_amount+seller_purchase_discount_type)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_2W ,(select IFNULL(SUM(product_instant_discount_amount+product_discount_coupon_amount+product_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discount_coupon_amount+seller_purchase_discount_amount+seller_discounts_amount+seller_purchase_discount_type)/sum(payment_amount) ,0) from SHOP_SALES_API where SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BPR_1W
,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND SETTLEMENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SETTLEMENT_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND SETTLEMENT_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_1W
,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND SETTLE_ESTIMATE_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_1W
,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SETTLE_ESTIMATE_AMOUNT),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} AND PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BSTS_1W
,(SELECT COUNT(ORDERER) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} and PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BDS_2W ,(SELECT COUNT(ORDERER) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID=#{shop_id} and PAID_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BDS_1W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(DELIVERED_DATE, ADDDATE(PAID_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY)))/COUNT(SHOP_ID),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID = #{shop_id} AND DELIVERED_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 4 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d')) AS BDLT_2W ,(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(DATEDIFF(DELIVERED_DATE, ADDDATE(PAID_DATE,INTERVAL 1 DAY)))/COUNT(SHOP_ID),0) FROM SHOP_SALES_API WHERE SHOP_TYPE=#{shop_type} AND SHOP_ID = #{shop_id} AND DELIVERED_DATE BETWEEN DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(),INTERVAL 2 WEEK),'%Y%m%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) AS BDLT_1W ) AS SSA_T;

SELECT ppr.MBID, ppr.PMS_GRADE, ppr.PMS_SCORE, ppr.SALES_TOTAL_SCORE, ppr.MANAGE_TOTAL_SCORE, DATE_FORMAT(ppr.INPUT_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') AS INPUT_DATE, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(ppr.INPUT_DATE, INTERVAL 13 DAY),'%Y-%m-%d') AS BIWEEK_DATE FROM PRIZM_PMS_RESULT ppr WHERE ppr.MBID = #{mbid} ORDER BY ppr.INPUT_DATE DESC LIMIT 2

SELECT PPCR_NO, MBID, SSA_BANK_ACCOUNT AS SBA, SSA_BANK_NAME AS SBN, SSA_BANK_ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS SBAH, CBC_BANK_NAME AS MBN, MUR_MB_DEMAND_ACC_HOLDER AS MDAH, MUR_MB_DEMAND_ACC_NUMBER AS MDAN, BALANCE_REMITTANCE_AMOUNT AS BRA, DATE_FORMAT(INPUT_DATE,'%m.%d') AS INPUT_DATE FROM PRIZM_PMS_CORE_RISK WHERE MBID = #{mbid} ORDER BY PPCR_NO DESC LIMIT 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRIZM_PMS_RESULT ( MBID, USER_CODE, PMS_GRADE, PMS_SCORE, SALES_TOTAL_SCORE, MANAGE_TOTAL_SCORE, BSVC, BSQC, BAUPC, BDSR, BPRC, BRRC, BSTSC, BDLTC, INPUT_DATE ) VALUES ( #{mbid}, #{user_code}, #{PMS_GRADE}, #{PMS_SCORE}, #{SALES_TOTAL_SCORE}, #{MANAGE_TOTAL_SCORE}, #{BSVC}, #{BSQC}, #{BAUPC}, #{BDSR}, #{BPRC}, #{BRRC}, #{BSTSC}, #{BDLTC}, DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') )
